'''''Cryptographie indéchiffrable''''' (English: '''''Indecipherable Cryptography)''''' (subtitle: ''basée sur de nouvelles combinaisons rationelles'' (''based on new rational combinations'')) is a French book on [[cryptography]] written by [[Émile Victor Théodore Myszkowski]], a retired [[French Army]] colonel, and published in 1902.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Myszkowski |first=Émile-Victor-Théodore (Lt-colonel) |url=https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k1265620p/f11.item.texteImage |title=Cryptographie indéchiffrable, basée sur de nouvelles combinaisons rationnelles |date=1902 |publisher=Société Française d'Imprimiere et de Libraire |location=15 Rue de Cluny, Paris |language=FR |trans-title=Indecipherable Cryptography}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |last=Myszkowski |first=Émile Victor Théodore |url=https://books.google.com.do/books/about/Cryptographie_ind%C3%A9chiffrable.html?id=L0m8QAAACAAJ&redir_esc=y |title=Cryptographie indéchiffrable: basée sur de nouvelles combinaisons rationelles |date=1902 |publisher=Societé Française d'imprimerie et de librairie |language=fr}}</ref>

His book described a [[cipher]] that the author had invented and claimed (incorrectly) was "[[Cryptanalysis|undecipherable]]" (i.e. secure against unauthorised attempts to read it). It was based on a form of [[repeated-key transposition]].
